privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: To take photos and video for your profile and chats, Grindr needs permission to access your camera.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: To let you access the app using Face ID if you enable a PIN
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: To show you people nearby, Grindr needs permission to access your location. Your exact location will not be shown.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you record audio clips and send voice messages.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To save a photo, Grindr needs permission to access your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To select a photo, Grindr needs permission to access your photo library.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Tracking helps us serve you relevant ads and keep Grindr free.
